failure_audit.reviewer: Codex agent; actual eight-frame sequences redecoded with frozen sampler and checked against persisted actual timestamps; raw pixels and center-crop geometry; no independent human sign-off
failure_audit.review_method: At least one annotated-occurrence context and Top-1 sampled sequence per missed query. Additional occurrences reviewed when evidence sufficiency was uncertain. Sheets are not continuous playback; center-crop geometry previews do not replicate pixel interpolation/normalization.
